doc.title: Bob Cranshaw interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

title: Closing: 'gotta have that groove'
summary: Woods thanks Cranshaw and they close on feel, groove and pocket.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And with that we’re going to kind of have to wrap up here, but you’ve told us some marvelous things. I think you’ve educated us. I think you’ve given our students and our listeners some things to hold on to, and I appreciate talking to you, and I really like your talking about the feel. Thank you.
Gotta have that feel in that music.
Gotta have that groove, that pocket.
Thank you. This has been our interview with Bob Cranshaw, for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
